title: Vegan Dark Chocolate Fudge
description: A rich and creamy vegan chocolate fudge made with dark chocolate and velvety texture.
instructions: Line an 8-inch square baking dish with parchment paper.
In a double boiler or a heatproof bowl set over a pot of simmering water, melt the chocolate.
In another bowl, whisk together the sugar and miso paste until well combined.
Once the chocolate has melted, remove from the heat and stir in the sugar mixture.
Stir in the coconut cream until well combined.
Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until firm.
